reader_question: What can these 2009 photographs show about art on Bhubaneswar’s streets, and what remains unknown about the makers?

source_inspections.finding: Camera metadata records 18 February 2009; the accompanying email is dated 19 February. The email supplies the quoted recollection. The archive contains 161 main art views and five alternatives; six unrelated event photographs remain outside this gallery. “Fresco” is the collection name, not a verified painting technique.
Historical STAMP project account: over 200,000 sq ft and four flyover underpasses. It describes a later programme, not the 2009 works.

image_review.finding: Eight selected photographs inspected directly. Coherent documentary views; full frames, photo dates and photographer credits retained. New captions describe visible details and distinguish comparisons from artist attribution. No image regenerated, retouched or cropped.
image_review.archive_integrity: 166 originals and 166 thumbnails checked against import hashes by existing full-site test.
image_review.limit: Visual reinspection covers the eight featured photographs, not specialist identification of every mural in the archive.

inventory: The main route remains an authored photographic archive. The separate /stories/bhubaneswar-fresco/story/ source is outside the coastal publication; not claimed revised or completed here.
limitations: Same-assistant review, not independent human or specialist review.
No artist, workshop, ritual purpose, exact street or present condition confirmed.
Original recollections and 2009 dates preserved; later cultural sources are context, not commission evidence.
